messages:
jon: noticed a sudden rise in GPU attach timeouts in eu-west3. Several attach jobs stalled with "PROVISIONING_HOLD".
priya: any storage signals?
ops-bot: [ALERT] eu-west3-pool-12: nvme_avg_latency 95th=250ms -> 1.2s; correctable_errors +7 in 10m.
emily: looking at janitor: nightly deep-scrub kicked off on that pool at 1759998600 with concurrency=10. That overlaps our onboard wave.
jon: that cohort is also running large batch launches. Small random fsyncs from onboarding + heavy scrub causing write amplification.
priya: immediate mitigation: lower janitor concurrency for that pool and prevent new attaches while we stabilize.
oncall-sre: agree. Also increase provisioner attach timeout to avoid transient flaps.
jon: applied quick patch: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_workers":"3","cohort_overrides":"eu-west3-pool-12:3"}}'
kubectl label nodes -l cohort=eu-west3-pool-12 no-new-gpu-attach=true
```
ops-bot: [INFO] patch applied by jon at 1759998875. janitor max_workers=3 for eu-west3-pool-12.
emily: ran brief iostat 30s after change: 
```
Device      r/s    w/s  await
nvme0n1     0.20  150.00  9.8
nvme1n1     0.02   20.00  0.9
```
priya: attach success rate improved from ~85% -> 97% in last 10m. Queue drained.
jon: ops: open ticket INFRA-4599 to track host replacements and to ingest SMART history; include cost calc for cross-region fallback.
finance-bot: quick note: moving 10% of provisioning to eu-north1 for 2h estimated extra cost ~$420 (reservations + egress).
oncall-sre: plan: 1) throttle scrub for affected cohorts (done) 2) prevent new attaches (done) 3) shift critical queues to fallback region for 2h (in progress) 4) schedule SMART long test + host replacement if badblocks continue (INFRA-4599).
emily: long-term: change scrub scheduler to avoid peak onboarding windows and cap default concurrency to 4. Also add automatic node-labeling when nvme errors spike.
jon: agreed. I'll post dashboard snapshots and follow-up in INFRA-4599. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
